text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to prohibit stopping at all times on the east and south side of Raymore Drive, from Brownlea Avenue to a point 55 metres north and east. The proposed prohibition was requested by an area resident, in consultation with staff and the Ward Councillor, to address concerns regarding congestion in the vicinity of the bend in the road.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the east and south side of Raymore Drive, between Brownlea Avenue and a point 55 metres north and east.
